name: The Silent Jungle
description:
About This Game

The Silent Jungle

War is a place where human values are buried beneath the rubble of life and death. Is there glory there? Or is it the weak breath and the prolonged silence after the gunfire?

During a mission in the dense jungles of Vietnam, Stephen and his squad are ambushed. Gravely wounded, he wakes up alone, disoriented, and lost. A strange, eerie fog blankets the jungle, hiding the scars of brutal battles and whispering the horrors of war. As Stephen searches for a way out, reality twists into a nightmare, images of war’s brutality, tortured souls, and his own haunted past gradually consume him. The deeper he ventures, the tighter the jungle’s grip becomes. Is there a way out, or has he already become part of this silent jungle?

Survive the unforgiving jungles of Vietnam

Immerse yourself in a classic-inspired nightmare, with a top-down view and an unrelenting eerie atmosphere.

Do you have the courage to fight... or will you run?

With limited supplies and enemies lurking in the shadows, every shot counts. Ammo is scarce—it could be your salvation or your doom.

Uncover the horrors of war

Amid the blood-soaked battleground, fear is your only certainty. The jungle echoes with the cries of the fallen, and every shadow hides a story of pain, madness, and something far worse. Survival is not just about fighting the enemy—it's about facing the terror war leaves behind.

  • A 3D top-down horror game inspired by classic survival horror, with old-school design and a relentlessly eerie atmosphere.

  • No guidance—you're on your own. Pay attention to dialogues, letters, notes—even items—and piece everything together yourself!

  • Fight terrifying creatures lurking in the shadows.

  • Avoid traps and environmental hazards

  • Trade spirit coins for healing, and survival advantages.

  • Every move matters. Moving while shooting will throw off your aim, and relentless action will drain your strength. Fight wisely—or fall.

  • Descend into the war’s underground tunnels—every corner hides deadly traps and unseen dangers.

  • Will you face demons... or the darkness within yourself?  

WELCOME TO THE JUNGLE...
short_desc: The Silent Jungle is a classic survival horror game set deep within the haunting jungles of Vietnam. After a brutal ambush, a lost American soldier must survive in a cursed jungle filled with lethal traps and haunting illusions. To escape, he must uncover its dark secrets and break the curse.
